arguments.title: Beacon Plaza — Investment / Sales Offering Memorandum (Revised)
arguments.subtitle: Revised 2026-09-01 · Charlotte, NC office asset · Original fictional evaluation material

sections.heading: Revision Summary
paragraphs: Source-backed analysis. Assumptions remain subject to diligence.

This revision incorporates the 2026-09-01 revised certified rent roll and the revision notice. Three inputs change relative to the prior OM: (1) Suite 010 moves from pending to active with monthly rent increased by $225 to $11,275; (2) the initial sizing rate rises 75 bps (note rate 6.7500% + 0.75% = 7.5000%, above the 6.00% floor); (3) the capitalization rate rises 25 bps to 7.7500%. All other underwriting rules, expense amounts, loan constraints, payoff, closing costs, and origination fee are unchanged.

Net effect: physical occupancy improves to 10/12 (the pending-in-occupancy risk is resolved). Gross potential rises to $1,621,500 and UW NOI to $1,044,819 before reserves, but the higher cap and sizing rates reduce capitalization value to $13,481,530 and reduce maximum loan (still LTV-binding) to $8,088,918. Net cash-out declines from $1,710,258 to $1,463,029.

sections.heading: Executive Summary
paragraphs: Beacon Plaza is a 12-suite office asset in Charlotte, NC totaling 66,360 SF. On the revised 2026-09-01 certified roll, ten suites (55,150 SF) are active and two suites (011, 012) remain vacant. Physical unit occupancy is 10/12 (0.8333).

Underwriting: GPR $1,621,500 + other income $4,200 × (1−5%) = EGI $1,544,415. Opex $499,596 (incl. mgmt $46,332). NOI before reserves $1,044,819; NCF after $3,600 reserves $1,041,219. Capitalized at 7.75% = $13,481,530.

Debt: sizing 7.50% × 30-yr amort, annual constant 0.083906. LTV 60% binds at $8,088,918 (DSCR $9,927,507; DY $11,569,095). Net cash-out $1,463,029 after 1% orig fee ($80,889), $45,000 closing, $6,500,000 payoff.
No asking price, market comps, photos or sponsor history are supplied.

sections.heading: Property & Suite Mix
paragraphs: Manager group mapping: A = Small, B = Standard, C = Large.

sections.heading: Lease & Occupancy Analysis
paragraphs: Unit occupancy 10/12 = 0.8333. Occupied area 55,150 SF / 66,360 SF = 0.8311. Suite 010 is now active at $11,275/month (up $225 from the prior $11,050 shown on the superseded roll). Suites 011 and 012 remain vacant. Suite 001 lease terms are unchanged: $11,050/month executed, expiration 2027-02-28 — still an active near-term rollover within 12 months of the 2026-08-31 evaluation date. Correspondence continues to confirm no free-rent or unsigned amendment affecting Suite 001.

sections.heading: Historical vs Underwritten Financials
paragraphs: Historical T12 reported NOI (cash) is $1,003,656. Underwriting is stabilized on the revised roll: GPR $1,621,500 + $4,200 other income; 5% loss produces EGI $1,544,415. Expenses use the prescribed amounts plus 3% management on EGI.

sections.heading: Debt Sizing (Revised)
paragraphs: Sizing rate is the greater of (note rate + 75 bps) = 7.5000% and the 6.0000% floor, so 7.5000% governs. Note that the note itself remains 6.7500% (unchanged) — the revision increases only the initial sizing rate. The floor is not binding.

sections.heading: Risks & Missing Diligence
paragraphs: Resolved / absent: pending-in-occupancy (Suite 010 is now active on the controlling roll); capital in opex (roof correctly capitalized); unsigned rent change (none in packet); temporary free rent (none); sizing floor binding (revised sizing 7.5000% exceeds 6.0000% floor); missing insurance (policy on file); refinance shortfall (net cash-out positive at $1,463,029).
Missing diligence unchanged: legal, environmental, PCA and title pending; no asking price, comps, photos or sponsor history supplied.

sections.heading: Source Notes
paragraphs: Revised roll dated 2026-09-01 supersedes the prior certified (2026-08-31) and archive (2026-06-30) rolls. Revision notice governs cap and sizing changes; all other instructions unchanged. All figures are original fictional evaluation material; no real transaction is represented.
